findings.summary: Muna Fidhin operated M5 Café and M5 Care as fraudulent FoF meal sites, claiming ~$1M for 300K+ meals never served
findings.detail: Muna Wais Fidhin enrolled her business M5 Café in the Federal Child Nutrition Program under the sponsorship of Feeding Our Future in 2020. In 2021 she also enrolled nonprofit M5 Care under a separate sponsor. She fraudulently claimed to serve 500 children/day, 7 days/week across two sites, billing for 300,000+ meals never served and claiming approximately $1 million in reimbursements. Funds used for mortgage payoff, car purchase, lifestyle, and overseas wire transfers.

findings.summary: M5 Care nonprofit (EIN 861998901) at 13198 Meadow Lane, Savage MN; involuntarily dissolved Jan 2023; M5 Care LLC formed same address Sept 2024
findings.detail: M5 Care nonprofit (EIN 861998901) was incorporated in Minnesota on February 5, 2021, at 13198 Meadow Lane, Savage, MN 55378 — the same address as Muna Fidhin's residence. It was involuntarily dissolved January 25, 2023. A separate M5 Care LLC was formed at the same address on September 17, 2024 (one month before the indictment was filed), and is also now inactive.

findings.summary: FoF fraud proceeds allegedly wired overseas via WorldRemit/Amal Financial to support Irro's Somaliland presidential campaign — the campaign that led to Abdirahman's ministerial appointment
findings.detail: The Fidhin indictment alleges that overseas wire transfers — via WorldRemit and Amal Financial — were made with fraud proceeds. Multiple sources report these transfers were directed to support Abdirahman Irro's Somaliland presidential campaign. Irro won the November 2024 election and subsequently appointed Abdirahman Daahir Aadan as Foreign Minister in December 2024.

findings.summary: Abdirahman Daahir Aadan is Somaliland's Foreign Minister, appointed Dec 2024 by Irro; prior Waddani VP candidate (2016)
findings.detail: Abdirahman Dahir Adam Bakal (Somali: Cabdiraxmaan Daahir Aadan Bakaal) was appointed Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of the Republic of Somaliland by President Abdirahman Mohamed Abdullahi (Irro) on December 14, 2024. He is a Waddani party politician from the Gadabuursi/Habar Affan sub-clan. He previously announced candidacy for the Waddani party VP slot in September 2016, campaigning in Gabiley, Dilla, and Borama.

findings.summary: Muna Fidhin held Waddani party U.S. chairwoman role and acted as Somaliland U.S. spokesperson; met Irro privately Nov 2024
findings.detail: Muna Wais Fidhin held the formal role of Waddani party U.S. branch chairwoman / U.S. representative at the time of her indictment. She also functioned as an informal spokesperson for Somaliland in the United States, publicly denouncing Al Jazeera reporting on Somaliland. She was personally received at President Irro's private residence in Hargeisa after his November 2024 election win.

findings.summary: Muna Fidhin donated $1K to MN Sen. Omar Fateh's mayoral campaign (July 2025); returned same day as her arrest (Sept 4, 2025)
findings.detail: Muna Wais Fidhin donated $1,000 (the maximum allowed contribution) to Minnesota State Senator Omar Fateh's Minneapolis mayoral campaign on July 10, 2025. Fateh returned the donation on September 4, 2025, the day Fidhin was arrested and her indictment unsealed. This was reportedly her first-ever political contribution. The donation appears in Minnesota state campaign finance records (not FEC, as it is a state race).

findings.summary: Abdirahman's wife Muna Wais Fidhin indicted as FoF defendant #75 (10 counts; Sept 4, 2025)
findings.detail: Muna Wais Fidhin (also Muna Waceys Fidhin), age 44, of Savage, MN 55378, wife of Abdirahman Daahir Aadan, was arrested and indicted September 4, 2025 as the 75th defendant in the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme. Case: United States v. Fidhin, 0:25-cr-00334-NEB-DTS, D. Minnesota. She faces 10 federal counts: 3 wire fraud (18 U.S.C. § 1343), 4 federal programs bribery (18 U.S.C. § 666), 3 money laundering (18 U.S.C. § 1957).

findings.summary: Muna Fidhin paid ~$27K in kickbacks to unnamed FoF employee who facilitated her fraudulent claims
findings.detail: Muna Wais Fidhin paid approximately $27,000 in kickbacks to an unnamed employee of Feeding Our Future who facilitated her fraudulent claims under the program. This employee identity has not been publicly disclosed in available press summaries.

connections.description: Abdirahman Daahir Aadan was appointed Somaliland FM by President Irro after the November 2024 election. Fidhin chairs the US branch of Irro's Waddani party. The alleged WorldRemit transfers from FOF proceeds were directed at Irro's presidential campaign.

Abdirahman Daahir Aadan is married to Muna Wais Fidhin, who was indicted as FoF defendant #75. They share a residential address at 13198 Meadow Lane, Savage MN 55378. Muna simultaneously held the Waddani party U.S. branch chairwoman role while her husband was a senior Waddani official and now Foreign Minister.

Abdirahman Daahir Aadan is the husband of Muna Wais Fidhin and Somaliland Foreign Minister appointed by President Irro. His Minnesota daycare business is named in the indictment as a money laundering vehicle for Fidhin's FOF proceeds. He is a PEP.
